cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: a broad bid, 59% of AI names green
cards.body: SPX +0.70% · BTC +0.75% · Gold +1.59% · Nasdaq100 +0.60%. At the last close, 59% of 101 AI names were green — a broad bid. Chip Equipment & AI Hardware did the heavy lifting at +2.03%.

cards.headline: Chip Equipment & AI Hardware leads, AI Chips & Compute lags
cards.body: Strongest AI sector is Chip Equipment & AI Hardware at +2.03%; weakest is AI Chips & Compute at -1.24%. Rotation within the AI trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: AMBA is the standout at +16.08%
cards.body: Leaders: AMBA +16.08%, AMZN +15.32%, ETN +7.32%, GOOGL +6.73%, NVT +6.24%. Laggards: AAPL -7.35%, NXPI -6.53%, MU -5.90%, OKLO -5.50%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: SpaceX (SPCX) -3.41% at $108.37
cards.body: The SpaceX debut keeps pulling attention — SPCX is -3.41% this session. The biggest IPO in history remains the tape's attention magnet.

cards.headline: AMBA moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: AMBA is +16.08% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.

cards.headline: Risk: AI bubble index 57 — Heating Up
cards.body: The composite AI Bubble Index sits at 57/100, led by Valuation at 85. Higher = frothier; the risk is everyone caring at once while valuations are already stretched.
